sources.dateOrElection: Queried 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-07 for the 2023 voting-place venues
sources.licence: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (https://osm.org/copyright). Raw responses are retained as provenance; attribution required.
limitations: Venue addresses come from the Electoral Commission voting-place files, which publish no coordinates; positions are geocoded, so they carry error (assumed standard deviations in docs/stage69-voting-place-notionals.md).
Queries ran one at a time with User-Agent "nz-election-model-2026-research/1.0 (+https://github.com/jamesfeng24/nz-election-model-2026)" (Nominatim usage policy: at most one request per second).
A venue is accepted only if the result lies inside, or within a stated buffer of, a 2020 electorate listing it; unaccepted venues are treated as non-place votes.
sources.organisation: OpenStreetMap contributors via the public Nominatim service (nominatim.openstreetmap.org)
sources.resource: Raw JSON responses, one line per query (query text, tier, HTTP status, retrieval time, response body)
